annotation.title_clean: 特定無線設備の技術基準適合証明等に関する規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance on Technical Regulations Conformity Certification etc. of Specified Radio Equipment
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications (now Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance (1981, revised to October 2026) implementing the Radio Act's conformity certification regime for specified radio equipment. It lists equipment categories, sets registration of certification bodies, certification procedures, design approval and self-confirmation for special equipment. No AI or robotics content ("radio robot" only as a weather device).
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines specified radio equipment subject to technical standards conformity certification
Sets registration and renewal procedures for registered certification bodies
Prescribes examination and testing methods and measuring instrument calibration
Covers design certification and approved certification bodies for foreign equipment
Establishes self-confirmation for special specified radio equipment
